MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. On which letter does the tone mark go in the syllable duì? (1 mark)
   A. u
   B. i
   C. No letter
   D. d

2. Which initial is said with a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. f
   B. m
   C. b
   D. p

3. What does 和 (hé) mean? (1 mark)
   A. And
   B. Mother
   C. Father
   D. That

4. Which Chinese word means "mother"? (1 mark)
   A. 谁 shéi
   B. 妹妹 mèimei
   C. 妈妈 māma
   D. 那 nà

5. Which room would you find a fridge in? (1 mark)
   A. 厕所 the toilet
   B. 厨房 the kitchen
   C. 客厅 the living room
   D. 卧室 the bedroom

6. What does 卧室 (wòshì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. In front of
   B. Chair
   C. Bedroom
   D. On

7. What does 昨天 zuótiān mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today
   B. Yesterday
   C. Tomorrow
   D. Morning

8. What does 星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Mosque
   B. Seven
   C. Friday
   D. To rest

9. Which word is pronounced wǒmen? (1 mark)
   A. 杯子
   B. 我们
   C. 来
   D. 送

10. What does 蜡烛 (làzhú) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To come
   B. Month
   C. Candle
   D. Birthday

11. What does 我喜欢吃香蕉 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a banana tree
   B. I am eating tea
   C. I like to eat bananas
   D. I do not like bananas

12. Which word is pronounced mǐfàn? (1 mark)
   A. 米饭
   B. 葡萄
   C. 饼
   D. 香蕉

13. Why is it good to retell what you heard in your own words? (1 mark)
   A. It shows you understood the key points
   B. It is a way to play
   C. It is only for teachers
   D. It makes you forget

14. What does 说 (shuō) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To listen, to hear
   B. To wash hands
   C. To speak
   D. Knee

15. Which is an extreme weather event? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳 the sun
   B. 风 a light breeze
   C. 洪水 a flood
   D. 云 a cloud

16. Which weather word means "cloud"? (1 mark)
   A. 风 fēng
   B. 云 yún
   C. 雪 xuě
   D. 雨 yǔ

17. Fill the blank: 沙发在门____。 (The sofa is beside the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 上面
   B. 里
   C. 下面
   D. 旁边

18. Where is the garden in 花园在房子右边? (1 mark)
   A. Inside the house
   B. Above the house
   C. On the right of the house
   D. On the left of the house

19. Which sentence means "My name is Xiaoming."? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 早上好!
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 再见!

20. Which Chinese word means "thank you"? (1 mark)
   A. 我 wǒ
   B. 你好 nǐ hǎo
   C. 叫 jiào
   D. 谢谢 xièxie

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three actions of the body and the part that does each. (3 marks)

22. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么. (2 marks)

23. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "That is my older brother." (2 marks)

24. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello!" (2 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." (2 marks)

26. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana." (4 marks)

27. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" (3 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My name is Xiaoming." (2 marks)

29. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 下雨 and 耳朵. (2 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Hello! (polite)" (2 marks)

31. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Happy birthday to you!" and "When is your birthday?" (4 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 来 and 笑. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — i
   With ui the mark goes on the second vowel, i.

2. D — p
   p has a puff of air, while b does not.

3. A — And
   和 (hé) means and.

4. C — 妈妈 māma
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

5. B — 厨房 the kitchen
   冰箱 is in the kitchen, 厨房.

6. C — Bedroom
   卧室 (wòshì) means bedroom.

7. B — Yesterday
   昨天 is yesterday.

8. C — Friday
   星期五 (xīngqīwǔ) means Friday.

9. B — 我们
   我们 is pronounced wǒmen and means we.

10. C — Candle
   蜡烛 (làzhú) means candle.

11. C — I like to eat bananas
   喜欢 is like, 吃 is eat and 香蕉 is banana.

12. A — 米饭
   米饭 is pronounced mǐfàn and means cooked rice.

13. A — It shows you understood the key points
   Retelling keeps the main ideas and shows understanding.

14. C — To speak
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

15. C — 洪水 a flood
   洪水 hóngshuǐ is a flood.

16. B — 云 yún
   云 is a cloud.

17. D — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

18. C — On the right of the house
   右边 is the right side.

19. A — 我叫小明。
   我叫小明。 (wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.) means "My name is Xiaoming.".

20. D — 谢谢 xièxie
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 看 with the eyes, 听 with the ears, 说 with the mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 那是我哥哥。 nà shì wǒ gēge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 你好! nǐ hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我叫小明。 wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: 下雨: xià yǔ, it rains. 耳朵: ěrduo, ear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 您好! nín hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

31. (4 marks)
   Answer: 祝你生日快乐! zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè! 你生日是几月几号? nǐ shēngrì shì jǐ yuè jǐ hào?
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 来: lái, to come. 笑: xiào, to laugh, to smile.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
